meta.description: Synthetic test vectors for CAS Phase Transition Theorem validation

cases.name: CPTT-1: Threshold Crossing — large drift
cases.description: law_drift far exceeds epsilon_L → must be Mutation

cases.name: CPTT-1: Threshold Crossing — just above epsilon
cases.description: law_drift slightly above epsilon_L (outside transition margin) → Mutation

cases.name: CPTT-2: Coherence Saturation — CG REFUSE with low drift
cases.description: CG not OK even though drift is small → must be Mutation

cases.name: CPTT-2: Coherence Saturation — CG REFUSE with zero drift
cases.description: CG failure with zero law change → Mutation (pure coherence break)

cases.name: CPTT-3: Transition Band — drift at boundary
cases.description: drift ≈ epsilon_L within margin, CG admissible → Transition

cases.name: CPTT-3: Transition Band — drift just below boundary
cases.description: drift slightly below epsilon within margin → Transition

cases.name: CPTT-4: Governance Phase Control — Mutation triggers FORK
cases.description: Mutation from threshold crossing must produce FORK/SHIFT/DEPRECATE

cases.name: CPTT-4: Governance Phase Control — Mutation from CG failure
cases.description: Mutation from coherence saturation must produce governance action

cases.name: Stable baseline — low drift, CG OK
cases.description: Well within stability basin → Stable with NOOP

cases.name: Compound failure — high drift AND CG REFUSE
